title: Automatons
intro: Census phase: vanilla data, plus the Ehlnofey target band of each record. The Dwemer machines: spiders, spheres, centurions, ballistas and the unique automatons, from the base game, the DLC and the Creation Club.

families.holds: the three-rung spider ladder (6 · 12 · 16), Bthalft's Warped spiders, Aicantar's Spider, the Forgotten Seasons Frosted spiders
the three-rung sphere ladder (16 · 24 · 30), Bthalft's Warped spheres, Kagrumez's Tempered Spheres, Sinderion's sphere
the three-rung centurion ladder (24 · 30 · 36), the Nchardak, Shimmermist and Irkngthand centurions, the Forgotten Seasons Harvest and Frosted centurions
the Forgemaster, The Messenger (Wraithguard), The Sky Orchestrator (Forgotten Seasons)

sweep.title: Membership sweep (2026-10-02)
sweep.text: Every NPC in Skyrim, Update, Dawnguard, HearthFires, Dragonborn and the 74 CC packs whose race is `DwarvenSpiderRace` 0131F3, `DwarvenSphereRace` 0131F2, `DwarvenCenturionRace` 0131F1, `DLC1LD_ForgemasterRace` 015C34:Dawnguard.esm, `DLC2DwarvenBallistaRace` 02B014:Dragonborn.esm, `ccAARSSE001DwarvenSpherePetRace` 000800 · `…SpiderPetRace` 000802 (ccafdsse001-dwesanctuary) or `ccBGSSSE010_PetDwarvenMudcrabRace` 000800 (ccbgssse010-petdwarvenarmoredmudcrab), followed through every template and `LVLN`; then every placed reference of them in every cell and worldspace, and every other record that names one of them or one of their placed refs. No quest or script adds to an automaton list at runtime. Placement counts leave out the dev cells `WarehouseAmbushes` 07E00F and `DLC2WarehouseAmbushes` 027333:Dragonborn.esm. Re-checked 2026-11-12: levels, template flags and lists. Everything found is on a family page except the following.
